title: No Hide By ALATIC
description: Toggleable mod that disables Minecraft’s obfuscated text so hidden messages become readable.
body:
No Hide By ALATIC is a simple client-side utility mod that lets you reveal obfuscated Minecraft text instantly.

Normally Minecraft uses the §k formatting code to scramble characters and hide text. This mod lets you toggle that off so the text becomes readable again.

Perfect for servers, messages, scoreboards, and any place where hidden text formatting is used.

**Features**

• Toggle the mod ON/OFF with the U key
• Shows ENABLED / DISABLED status in the action bar
• When enabled, obfuscated text renders as normal readable text
• Lightweight and client-side only
• No commands or config required

**Controls**

U → Toggle No Hide

**Compatibility**

Minecraft 1.21.11

Fabric Loader

Client-side only
